reviewMethod: Independent visual reading of all 20 original paper pages and scheme PDF pages 1–36, including all model solutions, allocation tables and detailed credit notes. All 32 distinct question and solution presentations visually inspected. The five nonzero table altitudes yield 36 practice cards. Publication follows the current one-card-per-printed-choice policy; legacy routes and source checks are retained in choice-policy.json.
sourceNotes: All 20 paper pages and scheme pages 1–36 inspected independently. Parallel legacy booklet remains separate.
32 printed tasks use 33 published scoring components. Q6(a) has two 10B derivative components; Q7(e,f) and Q9(c)(i,ii) each remain one joint 5-mark response.
Q9(b)(i) expands all five nonzero altitudes in the supplied table, each retaining 5B; 36 practice cards, 37 controls and 320 practice marks result.
Only starred scales allow full credit minus one. Q9(e,f) use their explicit detailed-note stars despite omission in the summary.

Q7(d) detailed header ends in 5 instead of 10. Q9(f) detailed header ends in 10 instead of 5 and includes a mid-credit paragraph despite a 5C scale. Published allocation table and scale table determine maxima; full conflicting originals retained with visible source notes.
